_comment: Asset manifest for scripts/art_gen.py. Each entry's 'prompt' is concatenated with the shared style fragment baked into art_gen.py. The master fox (mascot-fox.png) is uploaded as a reference image for every asset except itself, so the family resemblance stays consistent across generations.

vehicle-car.description: Slice 6 — friendly cartoon car, side-view, chunky.
vehicle-car.prompt:
Subject: A friendly cartoon car, side view, facing right. The car has an oversized rounded body (taller than realistic, about 1.4 height-to-length ratio), two big chunky black wheels with cream rims, a single large rounded windshield with a small white catchlight on it (matches the fox's eye highlight style), no driver visible, smiling round headlights.

Colour:
- Body: warm orange #ff8c42 (matches the fox)
- Wheels: deep charcoal #2a2a2a with cream #fff5e6 rims
- Windshield: pale sky peach #ffe1c0 with one small white catchlight
- A tiny blush pink #ff6b9d roof or detail accent

Background: TRANSPARENT — show the standard grey-and-white checkerboard pattern that image editors use to indicate transparency. No solid colour, no watercolor, no gradient, no atmospheric wash, no drop shadow. Post-process via remove.bg to strip the checker pattern cleanly.

animal-cow.description: Slice 6 side animal — cow waving from beside the road.
animal-cow.prompt:
Subject: A friendly cartoon cow, three-quarter view facing right, smiling, one front hoof raised in a small wave. Oversized round head, big round eyes with white catchlights, tiny rounded muzzle with a small smile, short rounded horns (not pointed).

Colour:
- Body: cream #fff5e6 with a few large soft blush pink #ff6b9d spots
- Hooves and horns: warm orange #ff8c42
- Inner ears, muzzle: cream #fff5e6
- Tiny blush dots on cheeks
- Eyes: deep brown with white catchlights

Backdrop: transparent / removed. Fallback: pure cream #fff5e6 background.

animal-bird.description: Slice 6 side animal — songbird waving from beside the road.
animal-bird.prompt:
Subject: A friendly cartoon songbird perched, three-quarter view facing right, smiling, one wing slightly raised mid-wave. Oversized round head, big round eyes with white catchlights, tiny rounded beak in a small closed smile.

Colour:
- Body: blush pink #ff6b9d
- Belly accent and inner wings: cream #fff5e6
- Beak and feet: warm orange #ff8c42
- Eyes: deep brown with white catchlights

Backdrop: transparent / removed. Fallback: pure cream #fff5e6 background.

animal-cat.description: Slice 6 side animal — cat waving from beside the road. Note: lighter orange than the fox so they read as different characters.
animal-cat.prompt:
Subject: A friendly cartoon cat sitting upright, three-quarter view facing right, smiling, one front paw raised in a small wave. Oversized round head, big round eyes with white catchlights, tiny rounded muzzle with three tiny whisker dots and a small closed-smile mouth, rounded non-pointy ears.

Colour:
- Body: lighter warm orange #ffb27a (push toward this shade so the cat reads as distinct from the fox)
- Belly, inner ears, snout: cream #fff5e6
- Tiny blush dot on each cheek: blush pink #ff6b9d
- Eyes: deep brown with white catchlights

Backdrop: transparent / removed. Fallback: pure cream #fff5e6 background.
